# openinfra_transit_gateway (Resource)

A hub for many kind: Vpc spokes giving transitive routing (a subnet-less kube-ovn hub Vpc) — the AWS Transit Gateway. Each spoke is also wired on its own kind: Vpc. Requires the kube-ovn CNI.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `attachments` (Attributes List) The spoke VPCs attached to this hub (a /30 peer link + a route to each spoke's CIDR). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attachments))
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.

<a id="nestedatt--attachments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attachments`

Required:

- `cidr` (String) The spoke's subnet CIDR, routed to via the hub.
- `hub_connect_ip` (String) The hub's IP on this spoke's /30, e.g. 169.254.101.1/30.
- `spoke_connect_ip` (String) The spoke's IP on the /30 (route next-hop from the hub).
- `vpc` (String) The spoke kind: Vpc.
